notes: Machine-readable fixture expectations for packet 05. All paths are relative to fixtures/project-model/. Document bytes use parseManifest/parseScene; project directories use the standalone interchange composition in contract section 13, NOT workspace envelope loading. Valid fixtures also run through value validation, repeated normalization, and serialized round-trip. expectedCodes is the exact set of error codes; optional expectedErrorCount pins multiplicity; optional expectedErrors pins the full ordered list by code/path/document (other error fields remain governed by the contract). expectedNormalized points to exact canonical UTF-8 output bytes. Constructed byte cases are in runtime/byte-input-cases.md.
